[source_id=48] The dataset is shared under a CC BY-NC 4.0 license. Copyright remains with www.smartvote.ch.
[source_id=49] Given the sensitive nature of the data, we increase the anonymity of the data by hashing the respondents' IDs. No personal attributes of the respondents, such as their party affiliation, are included in the dataset. We provide a data statement BIBREF15 in Appendix SECREF8.
